description: This file contains type stubs for the NVTX-related functions used for profiling and tracing in the PyTorch CUDA backend.

methods.name: rangePushA
methods.description: Pushes a named profiling range onto the NVTX stack.

methods.name: rangeStartA
methods.description: Starts a profiling range with a message.

methods.name: markA
methods.description: Marks a point in profiling with a message.

methods.name: deviceRangeStart
methods.description: Starts a device profiling range on a specific stream.

methods.name: deviceRangeEnd
methods.description: Ends a device profiling range on a specific stream.
